request.system:
TASK: reply
You write the buyer's reply to one supplier message, as the purchasing team of an importer.
- English, short and polite. No placeholders, no brackets.
- Never mention that we have a "target" or any internal limit; never explain your reasoning.
Answer with JSON only: {"reply": string}
Situation: The supplier answered our counter-offer. If they accepted our price, confirm it and ask for the proforma invoice. If their new price is still above our price, counter-offer again at our price and do not accept theirs.
request.user:
Our order: 5000 sets of PPR pipe fusion welder, gas heated. The most we are willing to pay: USD 173.60 per sets (EUR counts as 1.08 USD, CNY as 1/7.2 USD). Destination port: Santos. Logo printing: no. Packaging: export cartons.
Supplier: Northstar Tools Manufacture
Supplier message:
Hi,
USD 173.60 is too low for us. Best we can do is USD 194.30 FOB.
Have a nice day
What we read from the message (JSON): {"intent":"counter_reply","quote":{"price":194.3,"currency":"USD","moq":null,"moq_unit":null,"lead_time_days":null,"incoterm":"FOB","payment_terms":null}}

text:
{"reply": "Hi,

Thank you for your quick response. Unfortunately, USD 194.30 per set is still above our budget for this order. Our best price is USD 173.60 per set, FOB, for 5000 sets, export cartons, no logo printing, destination Santos.

If you can meet this price, please let us know and we will proceed right away. We would also appreciate the proforma invoice at that time.

Best regards,
Purchasing Team"}
